notablePrerequisites: Wizard Mentor does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning itself and Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat.
